notes.title: Update 1.2.2 - Steam Achievements Are On the Menu!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Crew Members![/p][p][/p][p]Two updates in a month - wowza! I'm very happy to bring Update 1.2.2 to y'all, a small but much requested one that finally brings Steam Achievements to the game. There are now 26 achievements to be unlocked for you completionists out there. All twenty six have been verified on our end to be acquirable, so happy hunting, y'all! Please be aware, since Steam Achievements weren't on our radar when we first released SMH, these are [u]not[/u] retro active. If you have technically completed an achievement prior to 1.2.2 (for example, finishing a character's route), you will need to do so again in order for Steam to recognize it. Just a reminder that you can quickly speed through dialogue by holding down the Left CTRL button!  [/p][p]HUGE THANKS TO [b]korytoombs/Sunflower Games[/b] FOR THEIR AMAZING WORK PUTTING TOGETHER THE PLUG-IN THAT ENABLES OUR ENGINE TO INTERACT WITH STEAM'S SDK! We never could have gotten this working without them - please consider supporting them on itch.io, and our heartfelt thanks again![/p][p]Lastly, this update also comes with a bug fix for the previously mentioned Quick Speed bug that occurred when switching between save files that were set at different campaign lengths. This issue should now be impossible reproduce, but as always - please let me know on the forums if there's any issues. [/p][p]Barring any huge changes in circumstance, this'll likely be my [i]real[/i] last update for a while. Very happy we got a chance to add these requested features. Thanks again, everybody, and HUGE welcome to the big influx of players who've picked up the game over the last month. Take care, ya wild cats![/p][p][/p][p]Elijah[/p][p][/p][p][i]Patch 1.2.2[/i][/p][p][i]Changelog:[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][i]Added 26 Steam Achievements across all routes of the game[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fixed a bug introduced in 1.2.1 that required players to fully exit the game if they wanted to play a normal length campaign after starting or loading into a save file set to a short campaign length[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.2.1 - Shorter Playthroughs, Additional Dialogues & More
notes.content: [p]Hello there![/p][p][/p][p]Surprise update! Just a small one - added a handful of more dialogue options, revisited the writing in a few scenes, fixed some typos, and, by request, added a campaign length option![/p][p]Upon launching a [u]new[/u] campaign, players will be prompted to choose their 'shift length' -- a Single (approx. 3-4 hour) or Double (approx. 7-8 hour) playthrough. The new abbreviated playthrough skips the prologue, the weekend heist, majority of Week II and most 'connective tissue' scenes. Additionally, a handful of scenes needed to be rewritten to introduce characters and themes like Patty that you'll need to be acquainted with for character routes that otherwise, in the abbreviated format, the player wouldn't have met yet. On the shortened campaign length, players only need to rack up a measly 4 Craveability Points to kick off a character's arc; the content and length of character arcs, including Solo, has not been edited, however - only the length of the Core Route has been adjusted. Please see the full changelog below for complete details of everything added/changed in 2.1.1.[/p][p]Just for full transparency, this update isn't reflective of a change of plans when it comes to future game updates - those are, unfortunately, still on ice. This was just a relatively quick update to knock out one of the things we promised (shorter campaign). We are still absolutely looking for a way to get Steam Achievements working - but as it stands, the VNM Engine absolutely hates Steamworks integration. If we can get it working, you can expect another li'l update.[/p][p]Please note, there is a pretty major issue specifically with changing between quick and normal speed playthroughs that just came to my attention after the update went Live. I already have several ideas of how to fix it, and will hit it with a fast patch soon as I can! Full details in the changelog. notes.title: Patch Notes for 1.2.1
notes.content:
Hello, there!

Small update incoming, with more details in just a bit. Here's the rough and tumble changelog:

[list]
[*] Implemented ‘campaign length’ option to enable shorter playthroughs, available when starting a new game
[*] Added option to partner with the General on Week 1, Friday Morning Exam
[*] Added option to either go with Nom Nom on Friday Morning and participate in the sky fight with Samuel Wich, or skip straight to class 
[*] Added variation of Week 1, Friday Night Nightclub scene to account for if the player didn’t go with Nom Nom that morning
[*] Added dialogue choice to Week 1, Monday Morning Pre-Class scene
[*] Added dialogue choices to Week 1, Tuesday Evening Expresso scene
[*] Added dialogue choice to Week 1, Thursday Morning Lunch scene
[*] Added dialogue choice to Week 1, Friday Morning Hotel scene
[*] Added dialogue choices to Week 1, Friday Afternoon Lunch scene
[*] Substantially decreased the previously egregious length of the Week 1, Wednesday Afternoon Beach scene between Saul and Mackie 
[*] Shooting Samuel Wich with the harpoon gun now awards players +1 Craveability with Sovereign, even though he isn’t physically present (presumably he felt your actions reverberate through your Soul Bond)
[*] Substantial flow and dialogue changes to the Week 1, Wednesday Expresso scene where the player meets Siren and Bae
[*] Minor reworking of dialogue across various scenes
[*] Adjusted volume for two lowest music settings to allow for even quieter tunes 
[*] Fixed various typos
[/list]
A post with a bit more information should be live just a bit later this morning. All the love!

Elijah and Co.

notes.title: Supersize My Heart - Update 1.2.0! Choices, Choices, Choices
notes.content:
Heya, Crew Members!

March is here, and our first update in 2025. Many hours and over 300 Canva assets later, we've made hundreds of little changes across the course of the game that I hope improve the experience. 

The biggest of which: I added choices to all four of the character routes, and the solo route. No longer does the game become strictly kinetic as soon as you start the final arc of your playthrough. These are very similar to the choices you'll find in the Common Route - but they're not meant to provide drastic branching paths. You'll still follow the story of the route - the choices (mostly dialogue options, like you'd find in an RPG) are more meant to let you express yourself and 'flavor' your experience. That being said, there *are* a few choices you can make that might straight up [i]bump you from your route[/i] - so watch out for those!

All in all, I'm very happy with this update. I think it vastly improves the experience. If you have any questions or encounter any bugs that I missed, please hit me up via email or here in Discussions and I'll get them taken care of ASAP! 

Next update, which I'm hoping will drop next month: abbreviated playthroughs and Steam Achievements! That'll be fun - I'll actually have to do a bit of coding for once, so fingers crossed! 

All the best! 

Elijah


P.S. 

You can find the more-or-less complete change list below:

[list]
[*] Added approx. 120 choices across the five routes (Mackie, Sovereign, Kai, the General, Solo)
[*] Added 3 new choices to Common Route scenes previously missing choices
[*] Player is now directly informed via an on-screen banner when they've exited the Common Route and started their final route, whatever that happens to be for their playthrough
[*] Player is informed via a direct message and via the Employee Handbook how many Craveability points they need to romance a character (7)
[*] Craveability needed to romance a character is now standardized (7)
[*] Player is informed Monday Morning, Week 1 how to skip through dialogue (Ctrl button)
[*] 'Sauce' has been added to the Music Library
[*] Dozens of edits across all routes to remove the most egregiously cringy dialogue I could find (some was left for posterity, and because some of it I find funny)
[*] Tweaks to dialogue when meeting Sovereign and Mackie for the first time
[*] Additional dialogue added to nearly all routes to clarify previously glossed-over narrative issues 
[*] Changed New Game+ messaging so it no longer refers to the Express Route as having no player choices
[*] Various minor scene flow changes across all routes
[*] About half a dozen spelling mistakes VANQUISHED
[/list]
